# Assignment test vector, to verify CRC computation
msg=0008123456784A090E98
mask=A5A5A5A5

# Assignment test vector with mask replaced by all ones, to verify that
# the modified CRC is the same as the unmodified CRC
msg=0008123456784A090E98
mask=FFFFFFFF

# Assignment test vector with non-zero message type
msg=4208123456784A090E98
mask=A5A5A5A5

# Verify that mask byte positions line up with message byte positions
msg=0008123456784A090E98
mask=FFFFFF00
msg=0008123456784A090E98
mask=FFFF00FF
msg=0008123456784A090E98
mask=FF00FFFF
msg=0008123456784A090E98
mask=00FFFFFF

# Reject incorrect length field
msg=0009123456784A090E98
mask=A5A5A5A5

# Reject incorrect CRC
msg=0008123456784A090E99
mask=A5A5A5A5

# Message that needs padding
msg=4205424AD0CF31
mask=FFFFFFFF

# Message ending in zero byte
msg=00081234560014D7F796
mask=FFFFFFFF

# That same message without the trailing zero byte, to verify that the
# output after padding is the same as for the previous test case
msg=0007123456D9C1A93A
mask=FFFFFFFF

# Verify that we mask only even words ("tetrads")
msg=000CFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF2144DF1C
mask=11223344

# Padded message of maximum size

mask=FFFFFFFF

# Message that is not a multiple of 4 bytes but too large to pad to a
# multiple of 4 bytes (given how the maximum message size is 256 bytes)
# and therefore should produce an error

mask=FFFFFFFF
